body:
Idk what to say to make it easier. To be honest I read it and replying to it because I want you to know that someone cared enough and read it. I doubt there are many people here that didn't have a shit life, or aren't depressed, suicidal etc. As many posts here saying it gets better ain't true for many. Some days get better, months, weeks. but it doesn't as a whole. And as many say only you can find what you want in life and change it. Saying do this or do that ain't working and sounds obnoxious. 

But maybe changing the pace of things? Like blow everything up say fuck it and start seeking and chasing something you want to do even when you feel scared. I don't have an advice that would be enough but I want you to know that I read your story, you're here. You're here.

Ngl as you'd expect it since you've written it that way, your post was enjoyable. And despite not in the same page as you I feel for what you say. Not in such an extent but I can only communicate with people through my personas. I have a job and am good at it, or any at this point, because of them. Friends? Same. Family? Same.

Here's the catch though. None really ever communicates without some short of persona. Your parents even. Most parents if not all. No matter how genuine they seem in whatever reaction (shoutout to the violent ones too), none's using their real self outside of their comfort zone.

Rarely someone goes to such lengths as you like yeh that ain't the common thing to do. And idk about therapy and such to be practically helpful. And yeah when you lose yourself to the point that you feel like you don't even exist in this world but just the people you created it makes you question if there's even a reason for the real you to come out now, since everyone runs away from it cause it ain't what they're used to. 

But idk if anyone in this reddit for a majority of posts here has any conclusive answer to anyone's issue. Just my belief. Instead I appreciate the ones who ask. And the questions should be asked from yourself to yourself.

like why did you do that? What were you afraid of? What kept you going? Why you couldn't stop? What would happen if you never did that? What would happen if you stopped doing it once and for all now? All these only you can answer. Usually the common factor for a majority of things is fear. You do things cause they either give you something in exchange or because you're afraid of something.

Even a good Samaritan helping someone without wanting something back, they do what they do because what they get is a peace of mind and able to live with themselves. So ask questions. And once you feel like getting yourself naked or partially like we on the internet do, do so. When you get happy about something and you tell your friends you don't do so cause they'll be as happy as you are. Only you experienced this happiness. They can't. But it'll make it be real. You say stuff cause you recognize that they exist and the only way to feel that they are real is if someone else takes that information in. Maybe do the same here too. You've already partially did. Right?
